name: Nykaa

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Moderate - 1–2 Medium DSA problems per round
rounds: Assignment or online coding round (60–90 min, 1–2 medium problems)
Technical round(s): further DSA, OS/DBMS basics

SDE-2.dsaDepth: Moderate - DSA plus system design; Java/Kotlin and threading depth expected
rounds: Coding round(s): 1–2 medium problems (data structures, string/array)
extraTopics: Java 8+ and multithreading (candidates note this as a hard requirement)
Spring Framework, relational and NoSQL databases, REST API design

SDE-3.dsaDepth: Heavy - machine coding plus HLD, then a managerial round
rounds: Round 2: machine coding (about 1.5 hr, e.g. a payment aggregator with multiple gateway modules, proper design patterns and running code)
Round 3: HLD round (about 1 hr, e.g. a multi-device notification service with read-status sync and priority handling)
Round 4: managerial round (project design deep-dive, situational questions, leadership principles)

ladder.title: Senior Software Engineer
ladder.notes: Reported as a distinct title from SDE-2/3

rolesNotes: SDE-1 through SDE-3 all have multiple independent reports; Senior Software Engineer is named but not detailed.
indiaNote: Reports come from Delhi/NCR and Bengaluru offices.
